reason: Provides configurable animated Canvas and video wallpapers for the DSH web interface, with controls for speed, density, opacity, and blur plus persistent browser settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供可调节速度、密度、透明度和模糊效果的 Canvas 动态壁纸及自定义视频背景。
summaries.en: Adds configurable Canvas animations and custom video backgrounds to the DSH web interface with controls for speed, density, opacity, and blur.

capabilities: Renders animated Canvas wallpaper backgrounds in the web interface
Plays user-provided local or remote video backgrounds
Stores wallpaper settings in browser localStorage
